music.title: Idomeneo
music.description: Mozart's opera seria of the Cretan king's vow to Neptune — the nostos rewritten as Idamante, Ilia, and a storm-born sacrifice.

popCulture.title: Idomeneus
popCulture.description: King of Crete's hundred cities — Homeric champion whose return ends in Leucus' usurpation and exile in Apollodorus' catalogue.

popCulture.title: Nostoi
popCulture.description: The Epic Cycle's Returns — the lost poem whose Cretan strand still frames Idomeneus among the captains who never came home clean.
